description:
A recursive function with k accumulators seeded [] and handed to any call gets 2^k activations: go/4 with three accumulators keys 8 times, one to six give 2..64. OptionParser.do_parse/5 has three and is 49% of AnalyzeActivation time in fixture 00761 (36 keys), which is why 00761/00762/00765 exceed the 20s fixture guard on CI.

Cause: the self call's accumulator argument is list(t) where the outside caller passed [], and the two never converge at a kept list slot, so each ascent state is its own key. recursion_supplied_positions already finds these slots but only the returned axis subtracts them; demand arriving through a forwarded call has no such rule.

Change: in prepare_function_call (src/compiler2/jobs/semantic.rs), when caller.function == callee, each whole slot the recursion supplies takes the caller activation's own key column. The argument's real type still goes into ActivationContribution, so it joins the activation's input evidence. All other slots key from the argument as today. The seed is identity; the ascent is evidence.

Acceptance (spike A2 measured these):
- fixture: three-accumulator go/4 (spike m/r3.fz) keys go/4 twice (non_empty_list(int) from the literal, list(int) from rest), and the six-accumulator form also twice; pinned through the backend dump.
- fixture: two outside callers seeding different element types (spike sound/seed2.fz) keep 2 keys returning list(int | :a) and list(int | binary) apart.
- do_parse/5: 1 key per configuration (00761: 36 -> 3).
- pins that move down, authorized: compiler2_input_demand_keys_one_activation_where_nothing_demands_the_slot walk/2 4 -> 2; compiler2_dispatch_blind_escape_census_is_the_known_population entry (153,140) -> (152,139). Any other pin movement is reported, not edited.
- .agent/docs/type-specialization.md (the 'one accumulator per function rather than a product' claim) and semantic-fixpoint.md state the rule.
- output identical on interp, run and build.

Proposal page: /Users/j5n/Workspace/optionparser-compile-cost.html (https://claude.ai/artifact/9MdFVrMJRKJcSULMazQfyo). Spike evidence: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/b3126377-4731-4b0b-825a-a57f770f6d53/scratchpad (spikeA2/spikeA2.diff).
title: A self call keeps its caller's key at a slot the recursion supplies
